newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 31.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones dropped 7.45 points to 6,021.93. PLDT's ADR slid by $0 3/8 to $59.50.
* The peso closed unchanged on Thursday at 26.285 to a U.S. dollar
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 2,964.00, up 36.70.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate unchanged 11.0625 pct.
